extraction.kind: focused offline PEReader CIL decode and dictionary/control matching

limits: Identifiers are not a count of unique features.
Only ExcelRibbonControlsBuilder dictionaries and their group creators are covered.
kind groups identifier families; known menu separators use their constructor type. controlClass is the first directly constructed CustomUI class, not an inferred runtime type.
Shared inherited getters are not resolved here; null actionId or controlClass is unknown, not absent.
Group reference does not prove visibility, demo access, or successful execution.
Broad REA member inventory was unavailable: 64 MiB metadata representation budget; focused existing PEReader output used instead.
